schema.description: A medium id (`oil`, `watercolour`, … see `media`) to paint this layer's marks with; absent or empty for plain vector art.

label: Align marks

label: Draw shapes
description: Draw shapes on a layer in one step: rect, ellipse, polygon, line, path (SVG d), text or stroke, each with fill, gradient, stroke and opacity. Give ids to address marks later. On a painted layer filled shapes are laid in with the brush.

params.name: layer
params.description: The layer to draw on; the top layer when absent.

schema.description: The layer to draw on; the top layer when absent.

id.description: An id to address the mark by later (`sun`, `hill-2`); one is made when absent.

oneOf.description: An axis-aligned rectangle; `radius` rounds its corners.
An open polyline through `points`, drawn with the stroke colour.
Text, first baseline at `y`; `\n` breaks lines.
A brush stroke: a smooth curve through `points`, `size` wide. Points are `[x, y]` or `[x, y, pressure]`; a handful of points is enough, the stroke is smoothed through them.

shape.description: The geometry: `{"kind": "rect", "x": 0, "y": 0, "width": 10, "height": 10}`, `ellipse` (cx, cy, rx, ry), `polygon`/`line` (points), `path` (d: SVG path data), `text` (x, y, text, size) or `stroke` (points, size).

stops.description: Colour stops: `[[0, "#ffd27a"], [1, "#e0603a"]]`; a stop's alpha (`#ffd27a00`) fades the paint out, for a glow or mist.

gradient.description: Instead of `fill`; on an oil layer the brush is remixed along it.

brush.description: Painted layers: the brush width a filled shape is laid in with.

angle.description: Painted layers: the brushwork's direction in degrees.

wet.description: Painted layers: paint into what is still wet.

shadow.description: A soft shadow cast by a mark.

group.description: A group id: edits naming it change the members as one.

clip.description: Cut to this mark's shape (opacity 0 hides that mark).
